name: Fear Me: The Silent
source:
A small adventure of horror, mystery, hope and quirkiness. 

Will you be able to save your family?

Will you be able to control your visions? 

Who will you be at the end of it all?

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/fear-me-the-silent]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场交织着恐怖、悬疑、希望与古怪趣味的小小冒险。

你能否拯救自己的家人？

你能否掌控脑海中的幻象？

当一切落下帷幕时，你又将成为怎样的人？

[摘自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/fear-me-the-silent]itch.io[/url]]
